_note: Cards (SPEC §13). All strengths are placeholders. where: battle or map. Stat boosts last for the rest of the battle (§11.7). weight: how likely a card is drawn against the others (1 if missing; rare cards less, round 9). Attack cards hit every enemy: damage = power - the target's PDEF (physical) or MDEF (magic), times the element multiplier, with the usual spread, at least 1.

art_text_box._note: Where a card's text goes on its picture (data/card_art/<id>.jpg), as fractions of the picture: left, top, right, bottom. The blank parchment panel under the name banner.

panther.name: Panther
panther.text: +30% STR for your squad for the rest of the battle.

elephant.name: Elephant
elephant.text: Each of your units gains 30% of its max HP, even above full, for this battle.

owl.name: Owl
owl.text: +30% INT for your squad for the rest of the battle.

cheetah.name: Cheetah
cheetah.text: Haste: +50% SPD for your squad for the rest of the battle.

raccoon.name: Raccoon
raccoon.text: +30% AGI for your squad for the rest of the battle.

turtle.name: Turtle
turtle.text: +30% PDEF for your squad for the rest of the battle.

hippo.name: Hippo
hippo.text: +30% MDEF for your squad for the rest of the battle.

whale.name: Whale
whale.text: All your units healed to full.

narwhal.name: Narwhal
narwhal.text: A narwhal healer at your squad's average level heals everyone twice.

walrus.name: Walrus
walrus.text: Cleanses all harmful statuses from your squad.

tiger.name: Tiger
tiger.text: A physical attack on the whole enemy squad.

crocodile.name: Crocodile
crocodile.text: A water magic attack on the whole enemy squad.

rhino.name: Rhino
rhino.text: An earth magic attack on the whole enemy squad.

condor.name: Condor
condor.text: A wind attack on the whole enemy squad.

angelfish.name: Angelfish
angelfish.text: A lightning attack on the whole enemy squad that shocks them.

mouse.name: Mouse
mouse.text: The enemy squad becomes weak to physical attacks.

mink.name: Mink
mink.text: The enemy squad becomes weak to magic.

chameleon.name: Chameleon
chameleon.text: This battle plays as if on your squad's home terrain.

sloth.name: Sloth
sloth.text: The enemy squad loses its next action.

unicorn.name: Unicorn
unicorn.text: Each of your units gets one extra attack this battle.

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.text: Every fallen unit in your squad rises again with half its max HP.
